installed_api.binding_caveat: Modern stream/kernel attribute value aliases use CUlaunchAttributeValue; do not copy the older CUDA11.4-only stream enum layout. The proposed getter-only query does not require these unions.

plausible_window.primary_discussion: d_children: one immutable existing CudaSlice<u32>, uploaded once from tree.children, reused in action down/up and evaluation. No new device payload is needed merely to describe its address range. Exact full flop array length has not been established by the selected retained reports; action-edge census is not that length because the allocation includes chance slots/SENTINEL entries. Record actual len*4 before choosing any extent; do not infer it from active action edges.
plausible_window.lifetime: Immutable metadata stays with its solver and is excluded from the seven mutable workspace swaps. Any window/graph referring to it must not survive that allocation; queued work must finish before cleanup/reuse of the address.

sized_alternative.basis: plan.rs230 allocates n u32 values; mod.rs369 uploads the complete vector. Archived D001 tree_nodes gives source-derived payload, not a new GPU observation. No winner selected.

plausible_window.cost_limits: Existing cache/coalescing/broadcast may already serve these reads. Whole windows can include cold/inactive entries. Reserving L2 can evict useful mutable data or compete with another solver. No miss-rate, bandwidth, residency, or >=2% headroom evidence exists here.

lifecycle_and_graph_constraints: GpuSolver constructor uses CudaContext::new(0), which retains the primary context. Per-solver save/set/restore of a context limit can overwrite another solver/library policy; reset is not per-buffer. Require a context-level ownership decision before setters are considered.

Training graphs and evaluation graphs must both receive the intended policy, as must eager/profile and standalone continuation paths. Setting only the graph-launch stream is not established to configure already-instantiated nodes.

cudarc end_capture immediately instantiates. Editing the retained graph after this cannot be assumed to change its executable. A later authorized implementation needs explicit node-policy verification before instantiation or a documented executable update path.

Locks invalidate graphs; warm constructors may capture on their first iterate. New capture, repeated solver construction/drop, shared context overlap, continuation board/workspace reuse and errors must all preserve attribute lifetime. Clearing a stream window does not by itself prove old persisting lines were normalized.
Do not reset the shared primary context. A cache-line reset or limit restoration, if ever used, must have separately justified ownership; simple per-solver RAII is insufficient for overlapping users.

minimum_next_observation.proposed: One no-kernel capability query, separately reviewed/authorized. ctypes avoids a Rust rebuild; explicitly type every ABI and pin nvcuda.dll identity.
getters: current persisting-limit bytes in query process retained primary context
minimum_next_observation.context_management: Retain, bind, query, unbind/restore prior current context, release in a finally path. No context reset. Report every CUresult and cleanup result; unsupported/error is not zero.
minimum_next_observation.interpretation: A positive capacity result permits further bounded design only. Zero maximum or unsupported API can stop this path. A zero current limit alone is not proof the hardware cannot support a separately configured policy. This query cannot establish graph inheritance, cache misses, or speed.

later_validation_if_separately_authorize: First prove window lifetime and actual captured-node attributes without assuming inheritance. Then exact raw/state/scale/root comparisons across eager, graphs, locks, warm state, evaluation and continuation/workspace paths; include shared-context ownership/error cleanup. Any performance candidate uses immutable E020 fixed complete-cycle three-pair gates and all construction/capture/readback costs, with broader and fresh original controls only if primary qualifies. No new threshold or outcome rescue.
